yeknal-application-security: Cross-stack secure-by-design guidance for authentication, authorization, sessions, APIs, supply chains, browser protections, and AI or agentic systems. Use for security-sensitive implementation and review.
yeknal-security-best-practices: Repository security review workflow grounded in the modern application-security baseline. Use for focused vulnerability and configuration audits.
yeknal-security-threat-model: Trust-boundary, asset, threat, and mitigation analysis including prompt injection, compromised tools, memory poisoning, and excessive agency. Use for threat modeling.
yeknal-security-ownership-map: Sensitive-code ownership, concentration, and CODEOWNERS comparison. Use for security stewardship and bus-factor analysis.
yeknal-markdown-management: Create, update, merge, split, rename, and audit Markdown or skill folders while preserving authority, links, anchors, provenance, and progressive disclosure.
yeknal-frontend-design: Compact anti-generic frontend design workflow adapted from Anthropic's current skill and subordinated to approved designs and narrower local aesthetics.
yeknal-ui-quality-baseline: Mandatory baseline for visible UI work covering tokens, typography, icons, responsive containment, loading states, purposeful motion, accessibility, and rendered QA.
yeknal-design-reference-research: Read-only-by-default research across live interfaces, galleries, flows, and source registries that produces evidence, a product-specific visual thesis, responsive transformations, and a rejection list before implementation.
yeknal-human-ai-interface-design: Trustworthy AI-product interaction guidance for expectations, appropriate reliance, provenance, uncertainty, user control, approvals, autonomy, recovery, and evaluation.

yeknal-design-taste-frontend-v1: Preserved original design-taste behavior for projects that explicitly depend on it.
yeknal-gpt-taste: Explicit compatibility route that delegates current premium work to high-end-visual-design and retires the fixed AIDA, randomized-bento, and mandatory-GSAP recipe.
yeknal-image-to-code: Image-first frontend analysis and implementation workflow.
yeknal-imagegen-frontend-web: Image-generation-only workflow for premium website design references.
yeknal-imagegen-frontend-mobile: Image-generation-only workflow for premium mobile concepts and flows.
yeknal-mobile-app-design: Native mobile screen and flow design or implementation, with optional Appllama reference research; delegates motion-only and image-only work to their focused skills.
yeknal-brandkit: Image-generation-only workflow for visual identity systems and brand-kit boards.
yeknal-redesign-existing-projects: Audits and upgrades existing interfaces without breaking behavior.

yeknal-industrial-brutalist-ui: Raw mechanical interfaces, Swiss typography, and extreme scale contrast.

yeknal-content-seo: Content and technical SEO workflow including IndexNow changed-URL notification and explicit receipt-versus-indexing proof boundaries.

yeknal-research-analysis: Canonical evidence-backed research workflow, including a progressively disclosed deep-research mode with claim verification and saturation-based stopping.
yeknal-i-have-adhd: Explicit-only persistent response mode with action-first structure, bounded steps, visible state, and evidence-based time estimates.
yeknal-break-ui: Adversarial worst-case data stress test for a component or screen, reporting each break and its fix against the shared UI quality baseline.
yeknal-domain-modeling: Clarify domain concepts, maintain a project glossary, and record durable architecture decisions as ADRs only when the tradeoff warrants it.
